houseRules: FanDuel Same Game Parlay, low wager, friend group.
9–10 legs, each roughly -300 to -500, aiming for about +1000 total (profit boosts help).
Best chance to hit near +1000, tilted toward legs where the stats beat the price.
Maxey-heavy. Milestone legs ("X+"): threes, steals, points + rebounds + assists ladders.
Usually two slips: 9 props, and a 10-leg version with the moneyline or a spread.

learned.rule: Skip Embiid threes, blocks and pts + reb + ast.
learned.why: Embiid legs are 4 for 15: threes 1 for 4, blocks 1 for 5, pts + reb + ast 2 for 6. Two of the three one-leg losses were Embiid legs.

learned.rule: Lean on Brown pts + reb + ast, VJ threes and LeBron steals.
Use small spreads (-2.5 to -5.5) or the moneyline, never big spreads (-7.5 or more).
learned.why: -2.5 and -5.5 went 3 for 3 and the moneyline 2 for 2; -7.5 missed by two (won by 6 as 9.5-point favorites at Chicago) and -12.5 by a point and a half.

learned.rule: Keep VJ's pts + reb + ast at 15+, not higher.
learned.why: 8 for 9, and the one miss (14 in the opener) cost a slip.

learned.rule: Maxey steals are fine, not core.
Keep pts + reb + ast legs to about 3.
learned.why: In the Nov 6 blowout, three of five missed together.

learned.rule: Check the final injury report about 30 minutes before tip.
learned.why: Embiid sits the second night of back-to-backs; LeBron and Brown have each missed a game.

learned.rule: Only use prices posted for this game. If a leg has no posted price, leave its price blank ("price unknown") instead of guessing or reusing another game's price.
learned.why: Prices move with the opponent. Against 1-6 Chicago on Nov 8, Maxey 4+ assists was -650, not the guessed -300, and VJ 1+ threes went from -430 (vs CLE) to -520.

learned.rule: Maxey 4+ assists is too short to use.
learned.why: -650 on FanDuel vs Chicago on Nov 8.
